subject: McGlynn School Ammunition Incident
overview: The Council requested an independent security assessment of municipal buildings amid intense public outcry over a delayed report of an ammunition magazine found at the McGlynn School. The Council also addressed short-term rental rules, private club smoking regulations, and routine licenses.

items.title: Inclusionary Housing Policies and Procedures
items.summary: Approved a resolution requesting that the Office of Community Development explain current inclusionary housing programs and policies to the Council.

items.title: Spring Playing Field and Playground Maintenance
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution requesting reports from city administration and public works on field preparations, field permitting processes, and playground equipment safety inspections.

items.title: Victualler License for Jim's Market
items.summary: Approved a victualler license transfer for Justin Howard operating Jim's Market at 51 Bow Street.

items.title: Subcommittee on Zoning Report
items.summary: Adopted the committee report detailing the reassignment of pending matters between the zoning and ordinance subcommittees.

items.title: Public Building Security Assessment and McGlynn School Incident
items.summary: Approved a resolution to issue an RFP for an independent safety assessment of all public buildings and requested police investigative reports following extensive questioning and public outcry regarding an ammunition magazine found at the McGlynn School complex in December.

items.title: Short-Term Rental Ordinance Report
items.summary: Adopted the subcommittee report recommending that the City Solicitor draft an ordinance regulating short-term rentals such as Airbnb.

items.title: Open Meeting Law Complaint Report
items.summary: Approved the Committee of the Whole report determining that an Open Meeting Law complaint was invalid and directing the City Solicitor to respond accordingly.

items.title: Public Hearing Notification Amendments
items.summary: Referred a response from the Community Development Board regarding expanded hearing notification requirements to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Private Club Smoking Ban Legal Opinion
items.summary: Referred a City Solicitor legal opinion concluding that the Board of Health exceeded its authority by banning smoking in private membership associations to the Committee of the Whole.

items.title: Meeting Records
items.summary: Approved the records of February 12, 2018, while records for February 6 were delayed.
